Build this kit to [`docs/kit-standard.md`](../blob/main/docs/kit-standard.md). One issue is one kit; split anything larger.

**Pieces:** <!-- every piece in the kit -->

**Sources:** <!-- CC0 sources to adapt, or "original" -->

**Review:** after merge <!-- or "mockup first" to stop and ask after the mockup -->

**Notes:** <!-- sizes, variations, anything else that matters -->
